title: Involution of Boolean duality
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{\\pm1\\}$. Define its dual by negating both the input and the output. Applying this duality twice returns $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\\{\\pm1\\}$
